problem:
What is the range of the function $f(x)=\frac{3}{4x-1}-\frac{6}{5}\,?$

The range is

worked_solution:
A transformed reciprocal function of the form

$$
f(x)=\frac{a}{bx+c}+d
$$

has the horizontal asymptote $y=d,$ and therefore, its range is

$$
f(x)\in (-\infty ,d)\cup (d,\infty ).
$$

In our case, $d=-\frac{6}{5}.$ Therefore, the horizontal asymptote is $y=-\frac{6}{5},$ and the range of the function is

$$
f(x)\in (-\infty ,-\frac{6}{5})⋃(-\frac{6}{5},\infty ).
$$
